conclusion: No blocking finding in the reviewed native change. Ready for submission after integration with the unchanged NInfer mainline; merge requires passing exact-head CI and a fresh base check.
review: Chronological resident subsets imply source slot >= destination slot. Ascending copies cannot overwrite a later unread source. Each run is bounded by the logical gap, physical discontinuities and 64 pages; the low-level API rejects overlapping physical ranges before submission.

Whole-address exclusive writer proof and COW precede mutation. Accepted coverage is revoked before asynchronous copies; native K/V/scales and per-layer maps retain exact ownership. Tests include shared checkpoints, both plane layouts, partial tails and successive different layer maps.

One private stream/event owner per pending lane. Producer ordering covers COW; completion validates stamp, lane epoch, address and frontier before publication. Abort drains private work before physical resource retirement, including partial submission and failed publication.

Prefill, decode and control-token consumers progress or defer pending Pressure. Ready/error status returns the request to the normal progress path; query/retire/detach cannot consume an unpublished owner.

Positive prefill progress followed by a storage wait uses existing quanta carry; zero progress charges nothing. Native pacing/service tests and long multi-request runs cover finite admission progress.

Host slots remain within the existing pinned allocation. Slot reuse waits its own producing ranks; diagnostic readback remains single-slot. Completion and exceptions drain submitted copies before buffer/source release.

Persistent private metadata is charged to the existing per-request allowance and checked against actual retained map capacity. No new full KV shadow allocation or increased pinned budget; COW remains subject to the existing physical pool.

Fast path is restricted to single-GPU target-only ordinary/DFlash2 Pressure. MTP, multi-rank and verification keep their established restore paths; all three documented override paths passed native tests.

Final source fingerprints match the packaged tree and qualified executable. Only seven Host translation units were built; no CUDA compile. All 51 patches replayed with intermediate tree checks and the new patch passed reverse/forward roundtrip.

Performance claims distinguish timing-enabled refresh diagnostics, same-output Task2/matrix and mixed free-generation observations. The mixed peer texts differ and are not claimed as a strict causal throughput comparison. No cross-platform or MTP qualification is inferred.
